lines: Reach a Bastion Remnant and bring back Gilded Blackstone for a risky settlement.
Gilded Debt is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
The bastion will not show itself. I refuse to chase a debt blind.
Gilded Blackstone is the proof. Without it, this is only an expensive apology.
Do not hand me gold and call it courage. Reach the bastion first.
Bastion near {target_x}, {target_z}. Gilded Blackstone for proof, one gold block for settlement. No second ledger.
The bastion is {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring Gilded Blackstone and one gold block. If you abandon this, I close the matter for good.
Settled. The village gains relief, and a few whispers it will deserve. Some rewards are complicated.
No. This ledger opens only for someone already trusted with sharp endings.
The settlement gold is ready.
Bring 1 gold block to settle the debt cleanly.
Gilded Debt
Add 1 gold block to settle the old debt.
Bring Gilded Blackstone and 1 gold block.
Return to the quest giver with the gilded proof.
Gilded Debt
Find the Bastion Remnant near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Enter a Woodland Mansion, defeat an evoker, and return with a Totem of Undying.
House of Ill Omens is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
The mansion is beyond my reach today. The woods are keeping their mouth shut.
Bring the Totem. Nothing else carries enough of that house on it.
The totem needs the mansion behind it. I need the place confirmed.
Woodland Mansion near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring down the evoker, bring the Totem, then 12 emeralds for the informants.
The mansion lies {direction}, around {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Defeat its evoker, bring a Totem of Undying, and set aside 12 emeralds for informants.
A Totem of Undying. That is not proof of safety, but it is proof the village has a shield with a name.
This is not a request for someone the village only half trusts.
The informant payment is ready.
Bring 12 emeralds to repay informants after the evoker falls.
The mansion's evoker is down.
Defeat 1 evoker inside the Woodland Mansion.
House of Ill Omens
Set aside 12 emeralds for informants after the evoker falls.
Defeat the mansion's evoker.
Bring a Totem of Undying after entering the mansion.
Return to the quest giver with the mansion proof.
House of Ill Omens
Enter the Woodland Mansion near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Reach a Nether Fortress and return with Nether Wart and a Blaze Rod.
Nether Wart Warranty is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
I cannot read a fortress route from here. The Nether is being unusually honest about being hostile.
Bring Nether Wart. The whole request is written around it.
Nether Wart without the fortress route is a guess. I need the place confirmed.
Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}. Nether Wart is the cure; a Blaze Rod proves you reached the heat of it.
The fortress mark sits {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod.
That will brew into more than medicine. It will brew into confidence. Take your reward.
This request needs steadier hands than you have shown me so far.
The blaze rod proves the route.
Bring 1 blaze rod so the cleric knows the fortress was real.
Nether Wart Warranty
Bring 1 blaze rod with the nether wart.
Collect nether wart and a blaze rod.
Return to the quest giver with the Nether proof.
Nether Wart Warranty
Find the fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Survey a Trial Chamber and return with a Trial Key and Breeze Rod.
Trial Chamber Recall is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
No chamber answers the map today. Maybe that is mercy.
Bring a Trial Key. It is the chamber admitting you were there.
The items matter after you set foot in the chamber itself.
Trial Chamber near {target_x}, {target_z}. Key, Breeze Rod, return alive enough to explain both.
The chamber is {direction}, roughly {distance} blocks from here, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a Trial Key and one Breeze Rod.
A key and a Breeze Rod. Good. That chamber can stay mysterious, but not unmeasured.
This request needs a better equipped ally.
The chamber hazard has been proven.
Bring 1 breeze rod from the chamber.
Trial Chamber Recall
Recover 1 Breeze Rod from the chamber.
Bring back a Trial Key and Breeze Rod.
Return to the quest giver with the Trial Chamber proof.
Trial Chamber Recall
Enter the Trial Chamber near {target_x}, {target_z}.
{quest} was abandoned.
You stepped away from {quest}. Come back when enough time has passed.
{quest} is no longer available after being abandoned.
{quest} is already complete.
{quest} is not active right now.
Your inventory is too full to receive the reward for {quest}.
I cannot find a valid target for {quest} right now.
You need to return to the villager who gave you {quest}.
There is still more to finish for {quest}.
Bring what I asked for before we close {quest}.
There is still more to do for {quest}.
How is {quest} coming along?
I have work that could use your hands: {quest}.
You finished {quest}. Thank you.
{quest} is not available right now.
Quest expired: {quest}
Reach an End City and bring back a Shulker Shell with a Chorus Flower sample.
End City Survey is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
The End refuses a clean mark today. Even maps know when to hesitate.
Bring a Shulker Shell. The city has to leave a hard signature.
A shell alone is not a survey. Reach the End City itself.
End City near {target_x}, {target_z}. Shulker Shell for proof, Chorus Flower for study. Try not to let the void edit the report.
The city mark is {direction}, about {distance} blocks from here, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a Shulker Shell and one Chorus Flower.
A shell and a Chorus Flower. The village has heard stories. Now it has evidence. Your name will travel farther than the road.
This survey waits for someone the village can trust with impossible directions.
The Chorus Flower sample is intact.
Bring 1 Chorus Flower as a living sample.
End City Survey
Keep 1 Chorus Flower sample intact.
Bring a Shulker Shell and 1 Chorus Flower.
Return to the quest giver with proof from the End City.
End City Survey
Reach the End City near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Follow a cartographer's rumor to an Ancient City and return with an Echo Shard.
Recovered {objective_item}.
Recover {objective_item} as proof of the journey.
Lost Civilization
Recover {proof_item} as proof of the journey.
Return to the cartographer with {proof_item}.
Lost Civilization
Reach the Ancient City center near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Search a shipwreck and return with a compass and paper before the route is forgotten.
Sunken Ledger is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
The coast is not answering. I cannot find a wreck worth sending you to.
Bring me a compass from the wreck. Direction is the point of this errand.
The compass matters after you reach the wreck itself.
Shipwreck near {target_x}, {target_z}. Compass for proof, paper for the ledger.
The wreck should be {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a compass and 8 paper for the copy.
A compass from the wreck and pages to save the route. Good. The water can keep the rest.
Not every villager should trust you with drowned records yet.
The blank pages are dry and ready.
Bring 8 paper to copy the damaged ledger.
Sunken Ledger
Collect 8 paper for a clean copy.
Bring a compass and 8 paper.
Return to the quest giver with the compass and paper.
Sunken Ledger
Reach the shipwreck near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Find nearby Trail Ruins and bring a brush and stone to restore the road marker.
The Broken Milestone is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
The road is too quiet today. I cannot find the broken marker from here.
Bring a brush from the work. A clean story needs its dust on it.
The stone is useful, but I need you to reach the ruins near the marker first.
Trail ruins near {target_x}, {target_z}. I need a brush for the old dust and 12 smooth stone for the new face.
The old mark is about {distance} blocks {direction}, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a brush and 12 smooth stone so we can set the route right.
Good. A repaired road is a quiet promise that someone can still come home.
That route is not ready for your hands yet.
The replacement stone is ready.
Bring 12 smooth stone for the repaired marker.
The Broken Milestone
Gather 12 smooth stone for the repair.
Bring a brush and 12 smooth stone.
Return to the quest giver with the brush and stone.
The Broken Milestone
Reach the old road mark near {target_x}, {target_z}.

Scout a Pillager Outpost and return with a crossbow as proof of the threat.
Fletcher's Countermark is already settled.
The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
I cannot pin the outpost from here. The mark may be old, or worse, moving.
Bring a crossbow from the threat. I want weight, not rumor.
A crossbow can come from many hands. I need you to scout the outpost itself.
Outpost near {target_x}, {target_z}. Crossbow for proof, 24 arrows so we answer properly.
The outpost lies {direction}, about {distance} blocks, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a crossbow and 24 arrows.
That is enough proof. The village will know where to point its fear, and its arrows.
You are not the scout I need for this yet.
The arrow bundle is ready.
Bring 24 arrows to restock the watch after the scout.
Fletcher's Countermark
Bundle 24 arrows for the village watch.
Bring back a crossbow and 24 arrows.
Return to the quest giver with the outpost proof.
Fletcher's Countermark
Scout the outpost near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Bring arrows so the village watch can answer trouble before it reaches the doors.
Watch Arrows is already settled.
The watch is not counting arrows right now.
No watch post is ready for another arrow request.
Bring the arrows before I restock the watch.
The watch still needs 16 arrows.
Sixteen arrows for the watch. Straight shafts, sharp points, no speeches needed.
Bring 16 arrows. The watch sleeps better when the quiver has weight.
Good. That is a little distance between danger and the doors.
The arrow request is closed for now.
The watch arrows are bundled.
Bring 16 arrows for the village watch.
Watch Arrows
Bring 16 arrows for the village watch.
Return to the quest giver with the arrow.
Watch Arrows
Bring beetroot for stews, pickling jars, and simple sickroom meals.
Beetroot Bundle is already settled.
The pantry list is not being counted right now.
No pantry slate is ready for another beetroot request yet.
Bring the beetroot before I call the bundle complete.
The pantry still needs 16 beetroot.
Sixteen beetroot for soups and pickling jars. Not glamorous, but glamour has never fed anyone.
Bring 16 beetroot. The stew pot looks more hopeful when it sees color.
Good. A little red in the pot makes hard meals feel planned.
The beetroot request is closed for now.
The beetroot bundle is tied and ready.
Bring 16 beetroot for the pantry.
Beetroot Bundle
Bring 16 beetroot for the pantry.
Return to the quest giver with the beetroot.
Beetroot Bundle
Bring sweet berries for quick meals and traveling pouches.
Berry Picking is already settled.
The berry baskets are not being counted right now.
No one has set out the berry baskets yet.
Bring the sweet berries before I call the baskets full.
The baskets still need 16 sweet berries.
Sixteen sweet berries for the stores. Mind the thorns; they are very committed.
Bring 16 sweet berries. Easy to bruise, easier to miss when they are gone.
Fresh enough. The children will call it dessert, and I will let them.
The berry request is closed for now.
The berry baskets are full.
Gather 16 sweet berries for village stores.
Berry Picking
Gather 16 sweet berries for village stores.
Return to the quest giver with the sweet berries.
Berry Picking
Bring glass bottles for tonics, inks, and careful measuring.
Bottle Stock is already settled.
The apothecary shelf is not taking bottles right now.
No shelf count is ready for another bottle request yet.
Bring the bottles before I restock the shelf.
The shelf still needs 12 glass bottles.
Twelve glass bottles. It is hard to keep remedies organized when they keep being liquid-shaped.
Bring 12 glass bottles. I can manage without drama; I would prefer not to manage without containers.
Good. Empty bottles are only boring until the village runs out of them.
The bottle request is closed for now.
The bottle shelf is stocked and ready.
Bring 12 glass bottles for the shelf.
Bottle Stock
Bring 12 glass bottles for the shelf.
Return to the quest giver with the glass bottles.
Bottle Stock
Bring bread so the village can stretch its stores through a hard night.
Bread Delivery is already settled.
The larder request is not open right now.
The stores are not ready for another bread request yet.
Bring the bread before we close this.
We still need all 16 bread for the stores.
Sixteen bread, if you can spare it. No heroics today, just weight on the shelf.
Bring me 16 bread. Simple work, but it keeps people steady.
Good. A full shelf makes brave talk sound less hollow. Take this with my thanks.
The bread shelves are closed to new help for now.
The bread is packed and ready.
Gather 16 bread for the village stores.
Bread Delivery
Bring 16 bread back to the quest giver.
Return to the quest giver with the bread.
Bread Delivery
Bring clay for small repairs around wells, ovens, and cracked walls.
Clay Repairs is already settled.
The repair bench is not taking clay right now.
No repair list is ready for a clay request yet.
Bring the clay before I mix the patchwork.
The repair bench still needs 16 clay balls.
Sixteen clay balls. Damp is fine; mud with ambition is still useful.
Bring 16 clay balls. I can patch three problems before they become one expensive one.
That will patch the little cracks before they learn confidence.
The clay repair request is closed for now.
The clay is ready for patching.
Bring 16 clay balls for village repairs.
Clay Repairs
Bring 16 clay balls for village repairs.
Return to the quest giver with the clay ball.
Clay Repairs
Bring eggs so the kitchens can stretch breakfast and broth.
Egg Baskets is already settled.
The breakfast baskets are not being counted right now.
No kitchen slate is ready for another egg request yet.
Bring the eggs before I call the baskets full.
The kitchen still needs 12 eggs.
Twelve eggs for the kitchen. Fragile, useful, and always somehow more urgent than they sound.
Bring 12 eggs. A quiet morning starts with full baskets.
Good. That is breakfast, broth, and one less complaint before dawn.
The egg request is closed for now.
The egg baskets are full and ready.
Bring 12 eggs for the kitchen baskets.
Egg Baskets
Bring 12 eggs for the kitchen baskets.
Return to the quest giver with the eggs.
Egg Baskets
Bring feathers so arrows and message shafts can be finished in proper batches.
Feather Fletching is already settled.
The fletching bench is not counting feathers right now.
No work order is ready for another feather request yet.
Bring the feathers before I tie the shafts.
The bench still needs 16 feathers.
Sixteen feathers for fletching. Straight arrows are easier when the back half agrees with the front.
Bring 16 feathers. A village with arrows walks differently at dusk.
Good. Feathers make the difference between warning shots and expensive guesses.
The feather request is closed for now.
The fletching bundle is ready.
Bring 16 feathers for the fletching bench.
Feather Fletching
Bring 16 feathers for the fletching bench.
Return to the quest giver with the feathers.
Feather Fletching
Bring cod for a simple village supper.
Fresh Cod is already settled.
The supper pot is not asking for fish right now.
No supper list is ready for a cod request yet.
Bring the cod before I call supper handled.
The pot still needs 10 cod.
Ten cod for supper. Fresh is best; recognizable is required.
Bring 10 cod. Not a feast, just enough to make the evening kinder.
That will do nicely. A hot pan can make morale out of fish.
The cod request is closed for now.
The supper fish is ready.
Bring 10 cod for supper.
Fresh Cod
Bring 10 cod for supper.
Return to the quest giver with the cod.
Fresh Cod
Bring ink so ledgers, maps, and warning notices remain legible.
Ink Supply is already settled.
The ledger desk is not taking ink right now.
No ledger note is ready for an ink request yet.
Bring the ink sacs before I refill the desk.
The ledger still needs 6 ink sacs.
Six ink sacs for the ledger. The village prefers its debts and warnings visible.
Bring 6 ink sacs. A ledger written in faded gray is just a future argument.
Dark ink. Excellent. Now our mistakes can be preserved properly.
The ink request is closed for now.
The ink is ready for the desk.
Bring 6 ink sacs for the ledger.
Ink Supply
Bring 6 ink sacs for the ledger.
Return to the quest giver with the ink sac.
Ink Supply
Bring coal to keep the kiln and forge work moving.
Kiln Fuel is already settled.
The kiln is not taking fuel right now.
The firebox list is not ready for another coal request.
Bring the coal before I stoke the firebox.
The firebox still needs 12 coal.
Twelve coal for the firebox. The work stops quickly when the heat does.
Bring 12 coal. The kiln is hungry, and hungry kilns become cold workshops.
Good fuel. We can make useful things instead of excuses.
The kiln fuel request is closed for now.
The coal is stacked by the firebox.
Bring 12 coal for the kiln and forge fires.
Kiln Fuel
Bring 12 coal for the kiln and forge fires.
Return to the quest giver with the coal.
Kiln Fuel
Bring leather for tool loops, armor straps, and pack repairs.
Leather Repairs is already settled.
The repair pile is not taking leather right now.
No strap list is ready for a leather request yet.
Bring the leather before I cut repair straps.
The repair pile still needs 8 leather.
Eight leather for repairs. Clean cuts save more work than clever knots.
Bring 8 leather. Half the village owns something held together by hope and a strap.
Good hide. This will keep handles on tools and packs on backs.
The leather repair request is closed for now.
The leather is cut-ready.
Bring 8 leather for repair straps.
Leather Repairs
Bring 8 leather for repair straps.
Return to the quest giver with the leather.
Leather Repairs
Bring paper so village records, maps, and warnings can stay current.
Map Paper is already settled.
The map desk is not taking paper right now.
The record desk is not ready to post a paper request.
Bring the paper before I copy the records.
The desk still needs 24 paper.
Twenty-four paper. Clean sheets, if possible; mystery stains become official history.
Bring 24 paper. Nothing heroic, unless you have seen what happens when records go missing.
Good paper. The kind that makes a warning look worth reading.
The paper request is closed for now.
The paper stack is ready.
Bring 24 paper for village notes and maps.
Map Paper
Bring 24 paper for village notes and maps.
Return to the quest giver with the paper.
Map Paper
Bring seed grain so the village can replant without touching winter stores.
Seed Stockpile is already settled.
The seed reserve is not open for counting right now.
The reserve ledger is not ready for another seed request.
Show me the wheat seeds before I mark the reserve full.
The reserve still needs the full 32 wheat seeds.
Thirty-two wheat seeds for the reserve. Small things become bread if we keep them safe.
Bring me 32 wheat seeds. It is humble work, which is why everyone notices when it is missing.
Good. That is tomorrow's field in a sack. Take this for your trouble.
The seed bin is not asking for help right now.
The seed sacks are tied and ready.
Bring 32 wheat seeds for the reserve.
Seed Stockpile
Bring 32 wheat seeds for the reserve.
Return to the quest giver with the wheat seeds.
Seed Stockpile
Bring torches so storehouses, pens, and work corners stay usable after dusk.
Torch Bundle is already settled.
The night rack is not taking torches right now.
No watch list is ready for another torch request yet.
Bring the torches before I mark the corners lit.
The watch rack still needs 16 torches.
Sixteen torches. The dark is cheap, which is why we spend so much avoiding it.
Bring 16 torches. I would like fewer surprises after sundown.
Good. Light does a lot for morale when walls start making noises.
The torch request is closed for now.
The torch rack is stocked and ready.
Bring 16 torches for the watch rack.
Torch Bundle
Bring 16 torches for the watch rack.
Return to the quest giver with the torches.
Torch Bundle
Bring lanterns before the watch loses the edges of the village to darkness.
Village Lanterns is already settled.
The watch is not posting a lantern request right now.
The watch cannot place another lantern request from here.
Bring the lanterns before we close this.
We still need all 6 lanterns for the watch.
Six lanterns, and sooner is better. Darkness will not wait.
Bring 6 lanterns soon; this request matters less after a couple of days.
That will hold the corners of the village a little brighter. Good work.
The watch is not ready to post that request right now.
Quest expired: {quest}
The lanterns are ready for hanging.
Bring 6 lanterns for the village watch.
Village Lanterns
Bring 6 lanterns before the request goes stale.
Return to the quest giver with the lanterns.
Village Lanterns
Bring wool for clean bedding and warm wraps.
Wool Blankets is already settled.
The bedding request is not open right now.
No sickbed list is ready for a wool request yet.
Bring the white wool before I mark the beds supplied.
The sickbeds still need 12 white wool.
Twelve white wool for the sickbeds. Soft, clean, and preferably not argued over by sheep.
Bring 12 white wool. Clean bedding does more healing than people admit.
Good. That is comfort with corners folded in.
The wool blanket request is closed for now.
The wool bundles are clean and ready.
Bring 12 white wool for sickbeds.
Wool Blankets
Bring 12 white wool for sickbeds.
Return to the quest giver with the white wool.
Wool Blankets
Stand watch and help defend the village from a real threat.
Standing Watch is already settled.
The watch is not calling for proof right now.
There is no watch post to mark on a map. Stay close enough to answer trouble.
Words do not hold a gate. Stand with us when danger reaches the village.
The village still needs to see you answer a real threat.
Stay near the village. If danger comes, answer it before it reaches the doors.
Arrows help. Nerves help more. Stand watch with us, and if danger comes, answer it.
You stood when it mattered. The watch will remember that.
The watch is not ready to ask this of you.
The village saw you defend it.
Defend the village from a real threat.
Standing Watch
Defend the village from a real threat.
Return to the quest giver after defending the village.
Standing Watch
